message: Last summer, we had a surprise blackout during dinner. My kids thought it was the best adventure ever—suddenly our living room turned into a cozy campout! I grabbed our trusty power bank to keep the phones charged for some flashlight fun, and we even pulled out a lantern for a little glow. It was a reminder that with a bit of prep, we can turn an unexpected moment into family bonding time. What’s your go-to trick for keeping the kids entertained during a power outage?
